channel.description: Last 10 notes on BBC WoW Campaign

item.title: The Booty Bay Chronicle
item.description: Printed in Booty Bay, where we sell to anyone who pays and ask nobody their business. Year 29 since the opening of the Dark Portal.

item.title: Death and Resurrection
item.description: Death and Resurrection The ruling No spirit healers. No corpse runs. No graveyard respawns.

item.title: House Rules
item.description: House Rules My deviations from the printed rules. Logged so I stay consistent.

item.title: Magic Schools and Damage Types
item.description: Magic Schools and Damage Types Azeroth runs on six. Everything resistible falls into one.

item.title: Playable Species at Launch
item.description: Playable Species at Launch Eight, and only eight. Four to a side.

item.title: Professions and Crafting
item.description: Professions and Crafting Primary Trades ProfessionTabletop HandlingBlacksmithingSmith’s tools.

item.title: Reputation as a Mechanic
item.description: Reputation as a Mechanic Vanilla’s eight-rank ladder, run as a real subsystem rather than a progress bar.

item.title: Travel and Downtime
item.description: Travel and Downtime Decided at the table Hearthstones exist, once per week. Flight paths exist and are expensive.

item.title: Book of Medivh
item.description: Book of Medivh Appearance A grimoire written by a man who was possessed while he wrote it, and nobody is entirely sure which parts were his.

item.title: Demon Soul
item.description: Demon Soul Appearance A plain golden disc, unmarked, that hums when it is near a dragon.
